stories.completionNotes: DONE (passes:true). US-409 = the PRODUCER side of the EDR sensor path (US-410 owns the sibling persistence subscriber; US-411 the end-to-end harness). Built ImuReader + LightReader on ONE shared _BaseSensorReader scaffold per the pmSignOff Rule-5 batch-similar exception -- the delta is the per-sensor read (IMU 4-topic burst+shared-seq vs light 2-topic+saturation), not a second scaffold. CONTRACT (ADR sections 1/3): IMU read as one burst per poll (accel+gyro+mag+temp) with all four raw.imu.* topics carrying the SAME seq (atomic burst -- read all before publishing so a mid-read fault emits nothing for that seq -> US-410 assembles one edr_imu_sample row per seq); light publishes raw.light.lux (None on saturation/non-finite, never inf) + raw.light.raw counts under its own independent seq stream. GRACEFUL-ABSENCE (the pld_sensor idiom): an injectable deviceFactory whose real default lazy-imports adafruit_icm20x/adafruit_tsl2591 and raises on a non-Pi host / absent bus; probe() catches -> present=False, logs once at WARN, publishes a RETAINED state.sensor.{imu,light}=absent marker, starts NO poll thread -> pure silence, zero fabricated samples. Flag-on-but-absent takes this path (never crashes) -- proven by tests using BOTH an injected raiser AND the real default factory on this dev box. Present -> retained state.sensor.*=present + daemon poll loop at sampleHz. STATE presence encoded as float on the Sample.value envelope (PRESENT=1.0/ABSENT=0.0) with a human 'present'/'absent' unit label -- the envelope is numeric (no string) and the shipped test_bus_state.py already encodes STATE as a float; a raw-topic assertion (not state) proves 'no fabricated 0.0'. ADDITIVE: readers only publish raw.imu.*/raw.light.*/state.sensor.* -- a raw.obd.* subscriber gets nothing (tested); LOSSY drop-oldest is the subscriber's concern so the producer never blocks by construction. FLAGS: pi.sensors.{imu,light}.enabled (default False) each REQUIRE pi.bus.enabled, enforced in createSensorReadersFromConfig (bus off -> empty list); sampleHz defaults 50/1. SCOPE-FENCE: did NOT wire into lifecycle.py (US-410 wires the full dark path: reader-start + sibling subscriber) and did NOT add persistHz/retentionDays (US-410 keys). One base-contract touch: Sample.value widened to include None (required for lux=None) -- annotation-only, back-compat, all Sample consumers (bus/persistence_subscriber/realtime) stay green. TDD red->green. GATES: tests/pi/sensors 15 + tests/test_config_validator (sensor+bus) all pass; tests/pi/bus + tests/pi/obdii/data + tests/pi/obdii/orchestrator regression all green (Sample widening clean); ruff clean on all modified files; python validate_config.py passes with the new keys. DEFERRED-PM: mypy not installed on dev box (module fully type-hinted; same defer as US-407/408). NEXT: US-410 consumes raw.imu.*/raw.light.* via a sibling subscriber -> edr_imu_sample/edr_light_sample (one IMU row per seq, drive_id NULL-latch per section 2.4, decimated persistHz, retention purge) + wires reader-start into lifecycle behind the flags.

pmSignOff.rationale: Rule-5 batch-similar exception: IMU + light readers share one reader module + the same probe/publish/graceful-absence/presence-STATE/flag scaffold; the per-sensor read logic (IMU 4-topic burst + shared seq vs light 2-topic + saturation) is the delta, not a second scaffold. Splitting would duplicate the scaffold across two stories. Build order: IMU reader first, then light on the same seams. If Ralph finds himself compressing, flag it and PM will split into US-409-a/-b.

stories.completionNotes: DONE (passes:true). US-410 = the CONSUMER/persistence side of the EDR sensor path (US-409 = producer readers; US-411 = end-to-end harness). Built EdrPersistenceSubscriber: a SIBLING of the OBD PersistenceSubscriber -- separate subscriber, separate topics (raw.imu.*/raw.light.* LOSSY, never raw.obd.*), separate tables (edr_imu_sample/edr_light_sample) -- so the F-110 byte-identical realtime_data golden master is untouched BY CONSTRUCTION (acceptance #5 / criterion 3). BURST ASSEMBLY (acceptance #1): the IMU reader publishes accel+gyro+mag+temp under ONE shared seq; the subscriber accumulates per (table,seq) and writes exactly ONE edr_imu_sample row per seq -- flushed on burst-complete (all 4 fields) OR on the next-seq boundary (a dropped field persists NULL -- honest gap), plus a final flush on stop(). Light assembles lux+raw under its own seq. DECIMATION (acceptance #2): whole-burst seq-decimation keep-1-of-N where N=round(imuSampleHz/imuPersistHz)=round(50/25)=2, so the 50Hz bus persists a 25Hz baseline (decimation is a SUBSCRIBER concern -- the bus still carries full 50Hz for a future live g-meter consumer, ADR 2.3); light is not decimated (persists at its 1Hz). DRIVE_ID NULL-LATCH (acceptance #3, ADR 2.4): drive_id stamped from getCurrentDriveId() ONLY when isDrivingFn() reports a RUNNING drive, else EXPLICIT NULL -- the fallback on any uncertainty (or a raising latch) is NULL, never a possibly-stale _currentDriveId. This mirrors the DTC-KOEO ruling (US-404) exactly: the isDrivingFn is wired in lifecycle to the live DriveDetector.isDriving() (the same gate event_router uses for the KOEO read); default (no fn injected) -> always-False -> NULL (safe default that never fabricates a drive attribution). Proven by a test that injects driveIdFn=lambda:7 + isDrivingFn=lambda:False and asserts the row is NULL (never inherit stale). RETENTION (acceptance #4, ADR 2.6): purgeExpired() DELETEs rows older than pi.sensors.retentionDays (default 7) from BOTH tables via lexicographic ts_utc<cutoff (utcIsoNow's fixed-width %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ is compare-safe). PIGGYBACK CHOICE: the purge runs on the SUBSCRIBER'S OWN drain thread via maybePurge() gated to at most hourly -- this is NOT a new daemon (the drain thread already exists for this feature), honoring ADR 2.6 'no new daemon' while keeping ALL EDR-persistence concerns in one SSOT module (no core.py runLoop edit -> lower base-module blast radius). maybePurge is unit-tested with an injected monotonic clock (not-due -> no delete; advance past interval -> delete). ALWAYS-ON (ADR 2.4): the subscriber persists every (decimated) sample regardless of drive state -- key-on incl engine-off is captured (true black-box); drive state only affects the drive_id STAMP, not WHETHER to persist. SHIPS DARK: createEdrPersistenceSubscriberFromConfig returns None unless pi.bus.enabled AND >=1 pi.sensors.{imu,light}.enabled; lifecycle _startEdrSensorPath is a no-op with the default flags off (nothing built, OBD path unchanged). SubStats observability via stats() passthrough. SCOPE: added only the 2 US-410 keys (imu.persistHz, retentionDays) -- US-409 already added imu/light enabled+sampleHz. TDD red->green (23 subscriber tests + 1 config test). GATES: tests/pi/bus (all) + tests/pi/sensors + tests/test_config_validator + tests/pi/obdii (full, incl orchestrator -- the base-module lifecycle change) all pass (1 pre-existing skip, 0 failures); ruff clean on all modified files; python validate_config.py passes with the 2 new keys. DEFERRED-PM: mypy not installed on dev box (module fully type-hinted; same defer as US-407/408/409). NEXT: US-411 (bench harness + golden-master regression + connect-when-wired drill) exercises reader->bus->subscriber end-to-end + proves the F-110 realtime_data golden master byte-identical with the EDR flags on.

stories.completionNotes: DONE (passes:true). US-411 = the VERIFICATION cap on the EDR sensor path (US-408 schema, US-409 producer readers, US-410 persistence subscriber). This is a bench-harness + golden-master-regression + drill-doc story -- NO production-code change: the EDR path already exists, so the harness wires the REAL production classes end-to-end with ONLY the two I2C device handles mocked (ImuReader+LightReader -> SampleBus -> EdrPersistenceSubscriber -> edr_imu_sample/edr_light_sample). Deterministic pump (probe + N x pollOnce + inline drain, no poll thread) so row count == poll count exactly -- reliable on the slow SMB share; the threaded start()/stop() lifecycle is already covered by US-410's TestEndToEndOverBus. ACCEPTANCE: (1) synthetic both-sensor harness -> one edr_imu_sample row per IMU burst seq [1,2,3] + light rows, with burst values + data_source='fixture' (honest synthetic tag, CHECK enum accepts it) mapped correctly; (2) absent path via _absentFactory (raises OSError like an absent I2C addr) with flags-on readers -> state.sensor.{imu,light}=absent on a watched STATE subscription + ZERO raw samples published (sub.poll() is None) + both EDR tables empty -- proves silence, never a fabricated 0.0/null; (3) golden-master reuses the F-110 discipline (tests/pi/bus/test_persistence_golden_master.py _COLS pattern): FLAGS-OFF -> createEdrPersistenceSubscriberFromConfig returns None (ships dark) and realtime_data via the bus OBD path == the inline logReading reference byte-for-byte; FLAGS-ON OBD-only -> a LIVE EDR subscriber coexists on the same bus but subscribes raw.imu.*/raw.light.* only, so publishing raw.obd.* leaves realtime_data byte-identical AND writes zero EDR rows (isolation by construction, ADR section 1.2); (4) _SaturatingLight.lux raises OverflowError -> LightReader publishes lux=None -> persists NULL + raw counts (65535,65535,65535), asserted never a float inf.
